Role: Solutions Architect
Company: Kobie

<job_posting>
Join a National Top Workplace 
Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where

requirements.text: 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements analysis, or technical pre-sales within a technology environment
Documents business requirements into BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs
Validates delivery cost estimates (COGS) across data/analytics, software, CS, and strategy workstreams
Applies Agile/Scrum, waterfall, and iterative delivery methodologies
Builds solution demos, proposals, and pitch materials for RFP, RFI, and upsell settings
Coordinates dependencies across marketing, data/analytics, and partner integration workstreams
Identifies scope drift and delivery risk and translates findings into corrective action plans
Working knowledge of loyalty marketing programs and mechanics
Delivery experience in retail, financial services, or travel & hospitality
Familiarity with MarTech platforms (e.g., campaign management, CDP, personalization tools)
Ability and willingness to travel as needed, up to about once per quarter
Remote/hybrid work arrangement, headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida
